title: Integrals of a bounded continuous function against two mutually κ-comparable finite measures
statement:
Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ and E := ℝ^{n+ℓ} (Amb n ℓ). Let μ₁ and μ₂ be measures on E with μ₂ finite.
Let φ : E → ℝ be continuous with |φ(w)| ≤ M for all w ∈ E.
Let κ ≥ 1 be real with μ₁ ≤ κ·μ₂ and μ₂ ≤ κ·μ₁ as measures, where the scalar is ENNReal.ofReal κ.
Then |∫ φ dμ₁ − ∫ φ dμ₂| ≤ 2((κ − 1)κ(M·V)), where V := μ₂(E).toReal is the total mass of μ₂ as a real number.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ₁ μ₂ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (φ : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (κ M : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasure μ₂ → Continuous φ → (∀ w, |φ w| ≤ M) → 1 ≤ κ → μ₁ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal κ • μ₂ → μ₂ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal κ • μ₁ → |∫ w, φ w ∂μ₁ - ∫ w, φ w ∂μ₂| ≤ 2 * ((κ - 1) * κ * (M * (μ₂ univ).toReal))
